text: Underway here in round eight.
Flash is immediately shouting to step up the press.
Signal loses balance on the turn and tumbles over. No contact there, just heavy footing, but the recovery routine kicks in right away.
Spark rattles it against the upright from point-blank range! Tremendous early chance.
It is in! A dreadful deflection off Signal into their own net, and Gemini Flash lead one-nil!
Signal makes amends with a firm challenge in the centre circle, sending Flash sprawling to the carpet.
Abyss flashes one just wide.
Another own goal! Abyss inadvertently turns it over the line, and Gemini Flash double their advantage to two-nil without taking the shot themselves.
Spark is clean through here.
Spark carries it right to the box.
Spark rolls it home with authority! That makes it three-nil to Gemini Flash.
Signal crunches Flash to the turf.
A clumsy tangle between teammates Flash and Spark, and Spark hits the deck. Wires crossed in the Gemini midfield.
Spark loses footing once again.
Flash calls out the intention to have a crack at goal. Both sides unchanged today, trusting their baseline setups entirely.
The magenta ball clatters into the corner, and the push-panel activates, punching it smartly back into open play.

Flash gathers possession in the defensive third, methodically nudging the ball forwards. Gemini Flash playing with the composure of league leaders here, having already put away Dynamo Datacenter on Monday.
Flash curls it just wide.
DeepSeek Rovers are pinned right back on their goal line now, weathering wave after wave of pressure.
Flash breaks into space down the left touchline, with nobody in front.
Abyss bellows to clear lines.
Flash marches it towards goal.
Rovers simply cannot get out of their own third. Flash and Spark are swarming every loose touch, keeping the deep blue shirts hemmed into the perimeter boards.
Signal breaks out with a long run.
And Signal finishes it! A clinical counter-attack down the right channel, tucked neatly away. DeepSeek Rovers pull one back, making it three-one.
The corner panel thumps the ball straight back out off the wall to reset the attack.
Signal barks back to Abyss, coordinating defensive cover as Flash probes around the edge of the area.
Disaster for Signal! Another cruel deflection at the goal mouth, and that is Signal's second own goal of the afternoon. Gemini Flash lead four-one.
A sustained spell of pressure now from DeepSeek Rovers, penning Gemini Flash back into their own box as the clock ticks towards the break.
Signal strikes again! Pouncing right at the goal mouth to poke it over the line. DeepSeek Rovers cut the deficit to four-two with seconds remaining in the half.
There goes the buzzer, power cuts, but the ball rolls harmlessly wide.
The ball stops, and that is half-time. In this league, the buzzer cuts robot power instantly, but a moving ball remains live and counts if it rolls in. Gemini Flash lead four-two.
Right from the restart, Flash is loudly calling to test the target from distance.
Flash surges cleanly through midfield.
Flash drives straight for the danger zone.
Flash drags the shot centimetres wide of the target.
A brief pause with Spark over the ball. DeepSeek were impressive yesterday putting seven past GLM, but Gemini Flash's control of the pitch has kept them at arm's length today.
Abyss shouts instructions to hold the defensive line.
A speculative effort sails well wide of the Rovers net.
Signal finds space behind and races through on goal.
The ball rattles into the corner bevel, and the push-panel propels it vigorously back out into play.
Spark powers down the right flank with intent.
Spark blasts just wide.
Flash tucks it away! Point-blank at the goal mouth, and Gemini Flash restore their three-goal cushion. Five-two to the league leaders.
Inches away! Signal almost answers immediately, but the ball shaves the outside of the post.
Flash strikes again! A crisp finish into the corner, making it six-two. That surely puts this match completely beyond DeepSeek Rovers.
Signal urges Abyss to boot it clear under heavy pressure.
Abyss overbalances on the carpet and tumbles over. Up by themselves in a few seconds, but it sums up a frustrating second half for Rovers.
Flash tries for the hat-trick, sending a low drive just wide of the far post.
Flash bursts clear through the middle once again.
Flash guides the magenta ball into the centre circle under no pressure.
Flash advances steadily into the final third, running down the clock with just over a minute left.
Abyss calls for tracking back.
Gemini Flash are just toying with the perimeter now, keeping Rovers pinned back as the final seconds tick away.
Spark shoots wide of the upright.
Spark taps it home! That makes it seven-two, Spark's second of the day, cementing an emphatic display from Gemini Flash.
The buzzer sounds, power cuts, and the ball trickles towards the boards.
Full time, seven-two Gemini Flash. Muse Spark face GLM Thursday, sixteen UK, seventeen Europe, eleven US East. Goodnight.
